note: Admissible water actions for the town development network. Dwell times, start limits, delays, costs, setpoints, reserve and protected minimum service are scenario engineering assumptions, not utility practice or public-health standards. Pumps are on/off only: no speed parameter is supported.
commitmentNote: Admissibility (protected service, reserve) is judged over the commitment window: the longest pump dwell (600 s) plus a decision period (300 s) plus actuator delay (60 s), with margin. Controllers re-decide every period, so a plan is not assumed to be held for the full forecast horizon.
